data.title: 空崎日奈 · 幽紫薄纱的静夜依偎
data.description: 忙碌到深夜的房间终于彻底安静下来，月光穿过薄纱窗帘在床单上铺开一层银辉。日奈穿着幽紫双层薄纱露背睡裙侧坐在柔软被褥边，轻轻垂下纤细的双肩，抬起小手轻拉你的袖口，柔声说「今晚能不能先别走，再多陪我五分钟就好」。
data.location: 月色轻洒的安静深夜卧房大床边
data.action: 侧坐柔软床沿轻拉来人衣角，微仰脸庞柔声挽留
data.lighting: 清雅银白月光与床头低暖柔光交汇，薄纱隐透轻盈层次
data.camera: 平视中近景，柔焦前景放大静谧依恋与脆弱感
data.mood: 脆弱、依赖、只对一人流露的撒娇与深情
data.promptProse: Sitting softly at the edge of her moonlit bed after a long day, Hina reaches out lightly and looks up with quiet vulnerability. Moonlight and dim bedside glow pass through the gossamer layers of her deep-violet chiffon babydoll nightdress, accentuating its tiny black satin bow and delicate open back.
data.animaCaption: Seated on her moonlit bed, she reaches out softly and looks up with tender vulnerability.
data.nsfwProse: Double-layer translucent violet chiffon drifts lightly across her shoulders and thighs under the pale bedroom moonlight.
